remarks: This one floor living home offers a little slice of paradise in one of the most beloved neighborhoods in Rowayton. Walk to town and train or bike to the beach from this completely updated 3 bedroom charmer on a cul de sac with brand new gunite pool with electric cover added in 2024 by Adaw Pools. Offering sunny open spaces with high end finishes, hardwood floors throughout and a large private deck and back yard with pool and all new decking, you have found home! Formal living room with fireplace and dining area. Generous gourmet kitchen with stone countertops and high-end appliances opens to the family room with vaulted ceiling and access to deck. The primary suite boasts built-ins with en suite bath and access to the back deck and pool. 2 additional bedrooms share a lovely, renovated bath. Great yard for pooch and play...Entertain inside and out and enjoy to your hearts delight!
